name: palette
title: PALETTE synth engine (four-tone layered digital synth, JD-08 style)
summary: Pick PALETTE in the engine list or the 'palette' preset: a layered digital synth in the style of the Roland JD-08 / JD-800. Every patch is up to four tones A-D, each a wave generator (24 own waves: band-limited saw, fat saw, square, pulses, PWM, triangle, sine, 14 additive single cycles mip-mapped, white / pink noise) with pitch envelope, a TVF (LPF 24 dB / BPF / HPF, resonance, envelope T1-T4 L1 L2 SUS L4, key follow) and a TVA envelope, two patch LFOs (tri, saw, square, S&H, random; delay, fade, key trigger) on pitch / cutoff / level. The four knobs are the palette: each page one row (LEVEL, WAVE, PITCH, CUTOFF, TIME), blue / green / white / orange = tone A / B / C / D; page 1 (tone levels) can be moved by TE's LFO. Polyphony counts tones (12: 1-2 tones 6 notes, 3 tones 4, 4 tones 3). Shift + blue turn browses P-- and 22 own patches; page 6 = the sound's FX knobs. The screen is a green LCD 20x2 dot display with four palette sliders. Own code and data (no Roland waves or patches). Presets stay drwave presets with in-range values.
controls: engine list: PALETTE; preset browser: folder palette (one preset, 'palette'); patches: shift + blue turn (P-- + 22)
PALETTE sound: knob push cycles page 1 LEVEL / 2 WAVE / 3 PITCH / 4 CUTOFF / 5 TIME (blue / green / white / orange = tone A / B / C / D) / 6 FX knobs
